fail_closed.MISSING_PAST_DEADLINE: expected path absent and now_tick > deadline_tick; dependents stay BLOCKED
fail_closed.PARTIAL_TRUNCATED: empty, undecodable, invalid JSON, non-object, or complete:false; dependents stay BLOCKED
fail_closed.SEAL_MISMATCH: parseable object whose seal_sha256 is missing or does not match canonical body; dependents stay BLOCKED
fail_closed.corrupt_ledger: truncated or checksum-mismatched wakeup ledger refuses to load rather than replay every event
fail_closed.synthetic_completion: dispatch of COMPLETED without matching sealed bytes on disk is refused

resident_callable.how_the_resident_uses_it: HCLI registers an expectation naming the output receipt, the verifier, the graph consumer and the frontier. The worker writes the receipt via atomic replace. A supervisor — possibly a different process after a restart — harvests the path and dispatch() wakes the three consumers. The model never asks whether it is done.
